answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 195 aliases, and each one needs its own funded prism account. Deposits are visible in anchor, and nebula reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 36% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 13 hours of verification and 2 percent more locked value. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
